# Launch Overseas Limited

> Launch Overseas Limited (領海品牌管理有限公司) is an institutional full-lifecycle brand management consultancy and multi-market distribution gateway headquartered in Hong Kong SAR. The firm specializes in cross-border GoGlobal market incubation, physical retail placement, US FDA and EU CPNP regulatory testing/certifications, and bonded logistics fulfillment via its 30,000+ sq ft central warehouse in Hong Kong.

## Canonical Portals
- [English International Gateway](https://launchoverseas.com/): Global brand management overview, services, commercial models, and corporate inquiry gateway.
- [Hong Kong & Traditional Chinese Portal (繁體中文)](https://launchoverseas.com/zh-hk.html): Strategic consultation for Hong Kong, Taiwan, and overseas enterprises.
- [Mainland China & Simplified Chinese Portal (简体中文)](https://launchoverseas.com/zh-cn.html): Cross-border brand scaling and export management for Mainland consumer brands.

## Verified Track-Record Case Studies
- [Florasis (花西子) Expansion](https://launchoverseas.com/#cases): Global rollout across US, Europe, and Japan; flagship retail placement in Isetan Shinjuku (2023), @cosme Osaka, and Tokyo Ginza (2025).
- [Spes (诗裴丝) Scaling](https://launchoverseas.com/#cases): Omnichannel personal care distribution scaling rapidly across TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopee, and Lazada with tens of millions in first-year revenue.
- [Voolga (敷尔佳) Distribution](https://launchoverseas.com/#cases): Medical skincare distribution across hundreds of offline retail doors and regional distributor networks in the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia.

## Service Pillars & Operational Capabilities
- Strategic Consulting & Market Incubation: Target market whitespace audits, localized formulation adaptation, and capital risk mitigation.
- Retail Distribution & Digital Channels: Direct placement across department stores, supermarket chains, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and localized D2C flagships.
- Integrated Marketing & Global PR: Features across Vogue, WWD, Forbes, and Elle, alongside tiered creator seeding on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
- Testing, Certification & Central Hub Logistics: US FDA notifications, EU CPNP toxicology files, and 30,000+ sq ft bonded staging with direct B2C global parcel dispatch.

## Legal Governance & Data Compliance
- [Privacy Policy](https://launchoverseas.com/privacy.html): B2B data protection standards under Hong Kong PDPO, EU GDPR, and China PIPL.
- [Terms of Service](https://launchoverseas.com/terms.html): Commercial governance, non-binding exploratory terms, and dispute resolution administered by the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre (HKIAC).
